description: National open government data provider. Represents the official government-run open data platform intended to serve as a source of publicly released datasets relevant to infrastructure and transport.
notes: Purpose: Acts as the national open government data provider within the provider registry. Intended use: Supplementary/official source for datasets published by government agencies. Future configuration: API endpoint(s), authentication details, and dataset/resource identifiers must be added manually during Stage 3B.2. Manual certification required: This provider must be manually reviewed and verified against the official government data platform before it can be marked verified or used for live data collection. No URLs, endpoints, or dataset IDs have been invented or pre-filled.
